\caption{Top ten contrastive caption words for every learned dimension. Subscripts give part of speech (N noun, V verb, Adj adjective, Adv adverb, O other); POS columns give each part of speech's share of the top-ten contrast. JS: Jensen--Shannon divergence (bits) between the caption word distributions of the two groups. Dimensions are ordered by greedy forward selection on the training RSM; the first 11 are those retained by the Kneedle elbow.}\label{tab:contrastive_top10_all}\\
